Tamarind Bio | Software Engineer | San Francisco ONSITE | https://www.tamarind.bio/

Tamarind hosts AI drug discovery models for biotech/pharma researchers. We’re building the infrastructure to power R&D in pharma companies and enable them to harness the latest advancements in computational biology, such as molecular ML models like AlphaFold.

We're hiring engineers who are excited to scale GPU inference, design intuitive applications for scientists, and build secure enterprise-grade software. We’re a series A company started 2 years ago, and have 10x’d revenue within the past year. We’re used by 7 of the top 20 pharma, dozens of biotechs, and tens of thousands of scientists. We’re hiring for a variety of engineering roles, including generalist software engineers and infrastructure engineers. We value ownership, moving quickly, and a focus on customer needs.

Stack: AWS, Python, React, Javascript, Kubernetes

Apply here: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/tamarind-bio/jobs or email me at sherry@tamarind.bio.
